name: Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 dual-channel Qwen2.5-32B Q4 dense decode - the desktop trap
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (llama.cpp discussion #19480, cited via runaihome EPYC piece). Strix Point laptop-class chip, dual-channel LPDDR5x only: a dual-channel desktop/mobile part lands ~3.5 t/s on a 32B dense Q4 - recorded as the negative datapoint showing why channel count, not core count, sets CPU decode.
